page.conflict: {name} saved version {version} at {time} while you were editing.
page.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens for the address.
page.slugReserved: /{slug} belongs to the site itself. Pick another address.
page.imageURL: Use an image address that starts with https:// or an image from the library.
page.needsWebsite: Members and paid pages need sign-in, which comes with the website. Turn the website on first.
page.tooBig: This page is too big to save. Remove some blocks or images.
page.atPast: Pick a time in the future.
page.tzInvalid: Pick a time zone from the list.
page.checksFailed: {count, plural, one {Fix the blocking check} other {Fix the # blocking checks}} before publishing.
page.changedMeanwhile: The page changed while you were publishing. Check it again, then publish.
page.redirectInvalid: Send readers to a path on the site, like /products.
page.undoLate: It's too late to undo: unpublish the page instead.
page.noApproval: Publishing pages doesn't need approval here: publish it directly.
page.nothingNew: Nothing changed since the live version: there's nothing to publish.
reminders.noEvent: Add event details with a date field to the page first.
reminders.unavailable: Automations aren't available on this server.
reminders.noTime: Set the event's date, start time and time zone first.

reminders.name.note: the reminder automation's name; title: the event's title
